001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign;

003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import java.awt.Color;

008import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;

021
022public class MonthlyReportNodeTooltipCreator implements TooltipCreator {
023
024        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
025                FDNode node = (FDNode) tooltipParam;
026
027                float pad = 3f;
028                float opad = 10f;
029                
030                //tooltip.addTitle(node.name);
031                
032                int crewSalary = Global.getSettings().getInt("crewSalary");
033                int marineSalary = Global.getSettings().getInt("marineSalary");
034                
035                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
036                        crewSalary *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_crewSalaryMult");
037                        crewSalary = (int) crewSalary;
038                        marineSalary *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_marineSalaryMult");
039                        marineSalary = (int) marineSalary;
040                }
041                
042                int officerBase = Global.getSettings().getInt("officerSalaryBase");
043                int officerPerLevel = Global.getSettings().getInt("officerSalaryPerLevel");
044                
045                float mult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_officerSalaryMult") : 1f;
046                if (mult != 1f) {
047                        officerBase *= mult;
048                        officerPerLevel *= mult;
049                }
050                
051                float storageFreeFraction = Global.getSettings().getFloat("storageFreeFraction");
052                
053                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
054                
055                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
056                Color color = faction.getBaseUIColor();
057                Color dark = faction.getDarkUIColor();
058                Color grid = faction.getGridUIColor();
059                Color bright = faction.getBrightUIColor();
060                
061                if (MonthlyReport.FLEET.equals(node.custom)) {
062                        tooltip.addPara("Fleet-related income and expenses.", 0);
063                } else if (MonthlyReport.OUTPOSTS.equals(node.custom)) {
064                        tooltip.addPara("Colony-related income and expenses.", 0);
065                } else if (MonthlyReport.PRODUCTION_WEAPONS.equals(node.custom)) {
066                        tooltip.addPara("Weapons and fighter LPCs installed on produced ships.", 0);
067                } else if (MonthlyReport.PRODUCTION.equals(node.custom)) {
068                        float currPad = 0f;
069                        if (node.custom2 instanceof CargoAPI) {
070                                CargoAPI cargo = (CargoAPI) node.custom2;
071                                if (!cargo.isEmpty()) {
072                                        tooltip.addSectionHeading("Equipment", color, dark, Alignment.MID, currPad);
073                                        tooltip.showCargo(cargo, 10, true, opad);
074                                        currPad = opad;
075                                }
076                                List<FleetMemberAPI> ships = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
077                                ships.addAll(cargo.getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy());
078                                if (!ships.isEmpty()) {
079                                        tooltip.addSectionHeading("Ships", color, dark, Alignment.MID, currPad);
080                                        tooltip.showShips(ships, 10, true, opad);
081                                }
082                        }
083                        
084                        FactionAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
085                        FactionProductionAPI prod = pf.getProduction();
086                        int accrued = prod.getAccruedProduction();
087                        if (accrued > 0) {
088                                tooltip.addPara("A total of %s worth of production effort has been put into projects that have not yet been " +
089                                                "completed.", currPad, Misc.getHighlightColor(), "" + Misc.getDGSCredits(accrued));
090                        }
091                        
092                } else if (MonthlyReport.STOCKPILING.equals(node.custom)) {
093                        if (node.custom2 instanceof CargoAPI) {
094                                tooltip.addPara("Expenses incurred due to the use of local stockpiles to counter shortages.", 0);
095                                CargoAPI cargo = (CargoAPI) node.custom2;
096                                if (!cargo.isEmpty()) {
097                                        tooltip.addSectionHeading("Resources", color, dark, Alignment.MID, opad);
098                                        tooltip.showCargo(cargo, 10, true, opad);
099                                }
100                                List<FleetMemberAPI> ships = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
101                                ships.addAll(cargo.getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy());
102                                if (!ships.isEmpty()) {
103                                        tooltip.addSectionHeading("Ships", color, dark, Alignment.MID, opad);
104                                        tooltip.showShips(ships, 10, true, opad);
105                                }
106                        }
107                } else if (MonthlyReport.RESTOCKING.equals(node.custom)) {
108                        if (node.custom2 instanceof CargoAPI) {
109                                tooltip.addPara("Expenses incurred due to the need to restock local stockpiles to replace the resources drawn by your fleet.", 0);
110                                CargoAPI cargo = (CargoAPI) node.custom2;
111                                if (!cargo.isEmpty()) {
112                                        tooltip.addSectionHeading("Resources", color, dark, Alignment.MID, opad);
113                                        tooltip.showCargo(cargo, 10, true, opad);
114                                }
115                                List<FleetMemberAPI> ships = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
116                                ships.addAll(cargo.getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy());
117                                if (!ships.isEmpty()) {
118                                        tooltip.addSectionHeading("Ships", color, dark, Alignment.MID, opad);
119                                        tooltip.showShips(ships, 10, true, opad);
120                                }
121                        }
122                } else if (MonthlyReport.OFFICERS.equals(node.custom)) {
123                        tooltip.addPara(
124                                        "Each officer receives a base salary of %s credits per month, plus %s credits per officer level.", 0,
125                                        h, Misc.getWithDGS(officerBase), Misc.getWithDGS(officerPerLevel));
126                } else if (MonthlyReport.COMBAT_PAY.equals(node.custom)) {
127                        tooltip.addPara(
128                                        "Combat bonus pay owed to your officers that could not be paid immediately due to a lack of funds.", 0);
129                } else if (MonthlyReport.ADMIN.equals(node.custom)) {
130                        float f = Global.getSettings().getFloat("idleAdminSalaryMult");
131                        tooltip.addPara(
132                                        "Each administrator receives a salary that depends on their skills. " +
133                                        "When not assigned to govern a colony, their salary is reduced to %s.", 0, 
134                                        Misc.getHighlightColor(), "" + (int)Math.round(f * 100f) + "%");
135                } else if (MonthlyReport.CREW.equals(node.custom) || MonthlyReport.RESERVE_CREW.equals(node.custom)) {
136                        tooltip.addPara("Each crew member receives a monthly salary based on the ship they are assigned to. "
137                                        + "Reserve crew above that required for the operation of all ships in the fleet "
138                                        + "receive a monthly salary of %s credits.", 0,
139                                        h, Misc.getWithDGS(crewSalary));
140//                      tooltip.addPara("Each crew member receives a base monthly salary of %s credits.", 0,
141//                                      h, Misc.getWithDGS(crewSalary));
142//                      tooltip.addPara("The salary of crew on certain ships, such as those with the Manual Systems hullmod, "
143//                                      + "may be higher or lower than base.", opad,
144//                                      h, "Manual Systems");
145//                      tooltip.addPara("When such ships are present, "
146//                                      + "the salary of reserve crew - above and beyond that required to run"
147//                                      + " all the ships in the fleet - is also affected, in proportion to the average salary "
148//                                      + "for all crewed ships.", opad);
149                } else if (MonthlyReport.JUMP_PAY.equals(node.custom)) {
150                        float jumpMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_jumpPayMult");
151                        tooltip.addPara(
152                                        "Jump pay owed to your crew that could not be paid immediately due to a lack of funds.", 0);
153                        tooltip.addPara("Long-standing spacer tradition holds that all crew receive a bonus equal to %s their "
154                                        + "base monthly pay when jumping out of a populated star system into hyperspace.", 
155                                        opad, Misc.getHighlightColor(), Misc.getRoundedValueMaxOneAfterDecimal(jumpMult) + Strings.X);                  
156                } else if (MonthlyReport.POSTPONE_RETIREMENT.equals(node.custom)) {
157                        tooltip.addPara("Increasingly sophisticated (and expensive) rejuvenation treatments, cybernetics, transplants, "
158                                        + "and the like.", 0);                  
159                } else if (MonthlyReport.SPACER_SHARE.equals(node.custom)) {
160                        float spacerShareMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_spacerSharePerMonth");
161                        int spacerShareMonths = Global.getSettings().getInt("ext_spacerShareThresholdSalaryMonths");
162                        int threshold = Misc.computeSpacerShareThreshold();
163
164                        tooltip.addPara("Long-standing spacer tradition holds that %s of the liquid funds of an independent operation, "
165                                        + "over and above %s months worth of pay for the crews and officers, "
166                                        + "shall be distributed monthly among all the personnel involved, "
167                                        + "whether they be found shipboard or planetside.", 0f, 
168                                        Misc.getHighlightColor(),
169                                        "" + (int) Math.round(spacerShareMult * 100f) + "%",
170                                        "" + spacerShareMonths);
171
172                        tooltip.addPara("It is thought to encourage greater daring in their captains, "
173                                        + "and a leader failing to abide by this custom would find themselves replaced "
174                                        + "very rapidly indeed. Gambits such as stocking up on supplies or holding on to "
175                                        + "particularly valuable cargo to reduce operating funds, "
176                                        + "however, are accepted and even expected of a crafty captain worth following.", opad);
177                                
178                        tooltip.addPara("%s months worth of salary for your fleet's personnel is %s. Any credits "
179                                        + "above that are subject to the Spacer's Share.", opad,
180                                        h, "" + spacerShareMonths, Misc.getDGSCredits(threshold));
181                        
182                } else if (MonthlyReport.MARINES.equals(node.custom)) {
183                        tooltip.addPara("Each marine receives a monthly salary of %s credits.", 0,
184                                        h, Misc.getWithDGS(marineSalary));
185                } else if (MonthlyReport.LAST_MONTH_DEBT.equals(node.custom)) {
186                        tooltip.addPara("Unpaid debt carried over from last month.", 0);
187                } else if (MonthlyReport.INDUSTRIES.equals(node.custom)) {
188                        tooltip.addPara("Upkeep and income from industries and structures located at the outpost or colony.", 0);
189                } else if (MonthlyReport.INCENTIVES.equals(node.custom)) {
190                        tooltip.addPara("Total spent on hazard pay and related growth incentives at the colony during the previous month.", 0);
191                } else if (MonthlyReport.CORRUPTION.equals(node.custom)) {
192                        tooltip.addPara("The inevitable inefficiencies and outright graft that come with the growth of any enterprise.", 0);
193                } else if (MonthlyReport.EXPORTS.equals(node.custom)) {
194                        tooltip.addPara("Income from out-of-faction exports by this outpost or colony. " +
195                                        "Smuggling and in-faction exports do not produce income.", 0);
196                } else if (MonthlyReport.STORAGE.equals(node.custom)) {
197//                      tooltip.addPara("Fees and expenses incurred by storing crew or materiel at a location. These include " +
198//                                      "things like rent (for populated planets) and life support/maintenance/etc for storage at an " +
199//                                      "otherwise-abandoned location.", 0);
200                        tooltip.addPara("Fees and expenses incurred by storing crew or materiel at a location. Includes rent, security, and other such.", 0);
201                        
202                        String percent = "" + (int) (storageFreeFraction * 100f) + "%";
203                        tooltip.addPara("The monthly expenses are generally %s of the base value of what's in storage.", 10f, h,
204                                                        percent);
205                        
206                        tooltip.addPara("Storage at a colony under your control does not incur any fees.", 10f);
207                } else if (node.custom instanceof CommodityOnMarketAPI) {
208                        float quantity = 0;
209                        if (node.custom2 instanceof Float) {
210                                quantity = (Float) node.custom2;
211                                if (quantity < 1) quantity = 1;
212                        }
213                        String units = "units";
214                        if (quantity <= 1) units = "unit";
215                        CommodityOnMarketAPI com = (CommodityOnMarketAPI) node.custom;
216                        tooltip.addPara("Approximately %s " + units + " of " + com.getCommodity().getName() + ".", 0f,
217                                        h, Misc.getWithDGS(quantity));
218                }
219//              else if (MonthlyReport.STORAGE_CARGO.equals(node.custom)) {
220//                      MarketAPI market = (MarketAPI) node.custom2;
221//                      //FactionAPI faction = market.getFaction();
222//                      Misc.addStorageInfo(tooltip, color, dark, market, false, true);
223//              } else if (MonthlyReport.STORAGE_SHIPS.equals(node.custom)) {
224//                      
225//              }
226                
227        }
228
229        
230        
231        public float getTooltipWidth(Object tooltipParam) {
232                return 450;
233        }
234
235        public boolean isTooltipExpandable(Object tooltipParam) {
236                return false;
237        }
238
239}
